profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at The Walt Disney Company
profile.summary:
Web developer at ESPN with experience in site metrics like omniture and javascript libraries. Currently working on a Disney proprietary template language but interested and actively developing in react.

Specialties: Web developing, statistics, site metrics, templating languages, flash, flex, html, SEO, Javascript, regionalization and internationalization

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Cultural Adaptation · Multitasking · Communication · Content Localization · Translation

positions.title: Software Engineer Front End 3
positions.description:
Spearheading the formation of new engineers (local and remote) into the technology team with training, code reviews, and documentation to help them focus on the larger picture that is supporting a massive international site with many different languages, markets, and needs.

12/1: Launch of the Netherlands Fox ESPN Edition
Led the onboarding of a new language to our code stack and localization for the migration of the site to our platform.

12/1: Redesign of the radio/podcast player experience for all editions.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Front End 3
positions.description:
Lead other developers building new, robust products with a global focus and available to all the regions of the company. We serve sports fans WHEREVER they are in WHATEVER language they speak. 
Development of knowledge transfer strategies for technical teams abroad.

positions.description: Responsible for the development and support of ESPN Deportes in the U.S. and ESPN.com in Latin America.

projects.title: Launch of redesigned espndeportes.com, espn.com.mx, espn.com.ve, espn.com.co, espn.com.ar and espn.cl
projects.description: Created and co-leaded the code base needed to launch editions of espn.com in any language and any region. Managed the training and on boarding of developers abroad.

projects.title: Regionalization of espndeportes for Latin America
projects.description:
Responsible for the regionalization and code split of espndeportes.espn.go.com. The site now serves 5 different domains:
www.espndeportes.com (USH)
www.espn.com.mx
www.espn.com.co
www.espn.com.ve
www.espn.com.ar
with localized content for the users.
